intended_object: The natural transformation, over the open normal subgroups S of a profinite group G, from the constant diagram A^G to the diagram of finite zeroth Tate groups Ĥ^0(G/S, A^S) = A^G / N_{G/S}(A^S) (with deflation maps), given levelwise by the quotient projection. Inferred from the docstring, the name and the module docs.
explanation: The component at S is finiteTateZeroπ, i.e. CompHausAddCommGrp.quotientRangeπ of the norm map from the finite coinvariants of A^S to A^G. The norm factors through the coinvariants, so its range is N_{G/S}(A^S). The domain is compact and the target Hausdorff, so this range is closed, and the topological quotient by the closed range has the algebraic Ĥ^0 as underlying group. The source diagram is constant at A^G with identity transitions. The target diagram uses the deflation maps for S ≤ T, which are well defined because N_{G/S} = N_{G/T}∘N_{T/S} with N_{T/S}(A^S) ⊆ A^T. Naturality is exactly the compatibility of these maps with the projections. The setting (a commutative ring R, a profinite group G, a representation with LevelCompact data) is the library's own framework, and Mathlib has no such construction. So the definition is faithful.
